description: The wait is almost over! Mortal Kombat II arrives in theaters and IMAX May 8. #MortalKombatMovie #FilmedForIMAX  From New Line Cinema comes the latest high-stakes installment in the blockbuster video game franchise in all its brutal glory, Mortal Kombat II. This time, the fan favorite champions—now joined by Johnny Cage himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.  Karl Urban stars as Johnny Cage, alongside Adeline Rudolph, Jessica McNamee, Josh Lawson, Ludi Lin, Mehcad Brooks, Tati Gabrielle, Lewis Tan, Damon Herriman, with Chin Han, Tadanobu Asano as Lord Raiden, Joe Taslim as Bi-Han, and Hiroyuki Sanada as Hanzo Hasashi and Scorpion.  Director Simon McQuoid returns to helm the follow up to his explosive 2021cinematic adventure, from a screenplay by Jeremy Slater, based on the videogame created by Ed Boon and John Tobias. The film is produced by Todd Garner, E. Bennett Walsh, James Wan, Toby Emmerich and Simon McQuoid, and executive produced by Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Jeremy Slater, Ed Boon and Lawrence Kasanoff.  Joining McQuoid behind the camera are director of photography Stephen F. Windon, production designer Yohei Taneda, editor Stuart Levy and costume designer Cappi Ireland, with casting by Rich Delia and music by Benjamin Wallfisch.   New Line Cinema Presents an Atomic Monster/Broken Road Production, a Fireside Films Production, Mortal Kombat II. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on May 8, 2026, and internationally beginning 6 May 2026.

description: Check out The Mummy Returns 25th anniversary trailer for the upcoming theatrical re-release of the sequel to the 1999 action film, The Mummy. The Mummy Returns stars Brendan Fraser (as Rick O’Connell) and Rachel Weisz (as Evelyn).   Set 10 years after the events of the first film, The Mummy Returns picks up in 1933 with the swashbuckling heroes now married and living in London. Parents to eight-year-old Alex (Freddie Boath), the couple brings the boy along to their Egyptian expeditions, where they inadvertently uncover a rare artifact, the Bracelet of Anubis. The piece once belonged to a fearsome warrior known as the Scorpion King (Dwayne Johnson in his feature film debut) and can be used to command his army of jackal-like fighters.   Back in London, trouble begins after the bracelet locks onto Alex’s wrist, just as a cult planning to resurrect the powerful mummy Imhotep (Arnold Vosloo), kidnaps Evelyn. Suddenly, father and son are forced to undertake a dangerous rescue mission alongside Evelyn’s spoiled brother (John Hannah), one that pits them against Meela Nais (Patricia Velasquez). The physical reincarnation of Imhotep’s ancient lover, she hopes Imhotep will defeat the Scorpion King in battle, thereby conquering the world.  Dodging all manner of unimaginable threats—death-defying chases, merciless hand-to-hand combat, even ritual sacrifice—the O’Connell family bravely fights to save the globe, and one another, from certain destruction.  The Mummy Returns, directed by Stephen Sommers, returns to US theaters on March 27, 2026 for a very special limited engagement.  #TheMummyReturns #Movies #IGN

description: A Tiny Monkey, A Plush Toy, and a Powerful Lesson on Love  Decode With Sudhir Chaudhary : The heartwarming story of Punch-kun, a baby monkey born in a Japanese zoo, has touched millions worldwide. Rejected by his mother at birth, Punch was left alone and vulnerable. Zoo staff introduced a soft orange orangutan toy, which Punch now clings to like a mother. Scientists describe this as “touch comfort” — the emotional security gained through physical closeness. Slowly, Punch is learning to socialize with other monkeys. This isn’t just an animal story; it’s a powerful reminder that love and comfort are essential for every living being. description: #breakingnews #hindinews #PunchKun #パンチくん #GanbarePunch #MonkeyWithPlushie #ViralMonkeyJapan #PunchKun #PunchMonkey #BabyMonkey #IchikawaZoo #JapaneseMacaque #ViralMonkey #AbandonedMonkey #StuffedToyFriend #PlushieMom #HeartwarmingAnimals #CuteMonkey #AnimalRescue #ZooLife #SnowMonkey #ViralAnimal #MonkeyWithToy #EmotionalSupport #JapanZoo #AdorableAnimals #AnimalLovers #MonkeyStory #RescueAnimal #CuteAnimals #ViralVideo   Meet Punch-kun (or simply Punch), the adorable baby Japanese macaque who has captured hearts worldwide!  Born on July 26, 2025, at Ichikawa City Zoo in Japan, this tiny 500g baby was abandoned by his mother right after birth due to extreme heat and exhaustion. With no other macaque in the troop stepping up to care for him, zoo keepers hand-raised him and saved his life.But surviving wasn't enough—Punch struggled with loneliness, insecurity, and rejection from the group. To help with his emotional development, caretakers gave him an orange stuffed orangutan toy (from IKEA!), which quickly became his 'surrogate mom.' Watch in this viral video as Punch clings to his plushie for comfort, hides behind it when scared, and even gets playfully (but dramatically) dragged by an older monkey—only to run back to his toy for safety!This touching story went mega-viral, melting millions of hearts and sparking global conversations about animal emotions, loneliness, mental health, and acceptance. This would put South Africa in the semifinals with six points and India with four. If South Africa loses to either West Indies or Zimbabwe, it would result in a three-point tie between the three teams with four points each. description: इंग्लैंड और पाकिस्तान के बीच टी20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026 सुपर 8 में रोमांचक मुकाबला हुआ। इंग्लैंड ने पाकिस्तान के निर्धारित 164 रनों के लक्ष्य का पीछा करते हुए हैरी ब्रूक के शानदार शतक की मदद से दो विकेट से जीत हासिल की। हैरी ब्रूक ने 51 गेंदों में जबरदस्त 100 रन बनाए और मैच का पूरा भार उठाया। पाकिस्तान की टीम ने पहले बल्लेबाजी करते हुए साहिबजादा फरहान की अर्धशतकीय पारी की बदौलत 164/9 का सम्मानजनक स्कोर बनाया। इंग्लैंड की तरफ से यह जीत उन्हें सेमीफाइनल की ओर एक बड़ा कदम बनाती है। पाकिस्तान की कोशिश भले ही जोरदार थी, लेकिन अंत में उन्हें हार का सामना करना पड़ा। यह मुकाबला रोमांचक अंत और हेड‑टू‑हेड संघर्ष से भरपूर रहा। दोनों टीमों के खिलाड़ियों ने दर्शकों को उम्दा प्रदर्शन दिखाया। इंग्लैंड की यह जीत सुपर 8 में उनके अभियान को और मजबूत बनाती है।     In a thrilling Super 8 encounter of the ICC T20 World Cup 2026, England edged past Pakistan by two wickets in a high‑pressure chase. England captain Harry Brook played a match‑winning innings, smashing a rapid century to guide his side home. Pakistan posted a competitive total of 164/9, powered by Sahibzada Farhan’s fifty. England’s chase was challenging, but Brook’s brilliant 100 helped seal the victory and secure England’s place in the semi‑finals. Pakistan fought hard with contributions from their batting lineup but ultimately fell short. The encounter provided intense moments, tight competition, and a dramatic finish. Cricket fans witnessed an excellent display of talent from both sides. description: For years I blamed myself. For my body. For my belly. For not ‘working hard enough.’ Turns out… it wasn’t in my head. This is my ovarian cyst removal journey.  DISCLAIMER ALERT 🚨   I’m sharing my personal journey with cyst removal surgery to spread awareness and help anyone who might relate. I am not a medical expert, and this video should not be taken as medical advice. Please consult your gynecologist or healthcare provider for proper diagnosis and treatment.  I want to clarify something very honestly.  I’ve always been transparent about my health journey. For a long time, I felt unheard and not properly guided in my earlier consultations, which unfortunately allowed my condition to become more serious over time. This is not to blame anyone, but to express how important it is for patients to feel truly listened to.  I’m extremely grateful for my current doctor, who took the time to carefully read my entire case history from start to end, understood my struggles, and guided me properly. title: Man Sets Motorcycle On Fire After Being Told Not To Light Cigarette At Petrol Pump
tags: NDTV 24x7|breaking news|current affairs|latest news|live news|ndtv|ndtv live 24x7 english news|petrolpump_178879|top news|category= news|Raipur News|Show= Daily News Videos|Viral Video|Raipur News Today|Raipur Petrol Pump
description: Two accused have been arrested for setting their own motorcycle on fire at a petrol pump in Raipur. A video of the incident had gone viral on social media.  The incident took place on February 18 at around 7:40 PM at Sangeeta Petrol Pump located at Karma Chowk under the Urla police station limits in Raipur.  According to police, two men arrived at the petrol pump on a motorcycle to refuel. While the petrol pump employee was filling fuel, the pillion rider got down and attempted to light a cigarette using a lighter.  When the petrol pump staff objected, the man deliberately ignited the lighter and set fire to the motorcycle’s fuel tank while petrol was being filled. The flames quickly spread to the motorcycle tank and the petrol machine nozzle.  However, due to the alertness of the petrol pump staff, the fire was brought under control immediately, preventing a major accident.  Based on the complaint filed by the petrol pump employee, a case was registered at Urla Police Station under Sections 326 (misconduct by fire), 287, and 125 of the BNS.  Under the leadership of the Station House Officer of Urla, a police team traced and identified the accused as Dharmendra Singh Kshatriya and Imran Qureshi. Both were arrested, and the motorcycle and lighter used in the incident were seized. description: Today, in our village, we prepare delicious KULFI ICE using fresh, homemade cow milk in our traditional style. We slowly cook the milk for nearly 6 hours, reducing it from 3 parts to 1 to achieve a thick, rich, creamy texture.  We make natural colors, pink from fresh dragon fruit, and blue from spirulina powder. We pour the mixture into molds and freeze it for 12 hours.  On a hot summer evening, we enjoy this healthy, colorful homemade milk kulfi as a refreshing summer dessert. The taste is Yummy!
